2. Step-by-Step Filling Process Login: Go to the MSBTE Official Portal and click on the Exam Form link. You will need your Enrollment Number and a Password (usually provided by your college's exam cell). Verify Details: Once logged in, verify your personal details (Name, Father's Name, Mother's Name) and your course information. Select Subjects: Ensure all the subjects you are appearing for (both Theory and Practical/Oral) are correctly listed. Submit and Print: Click Submit to generate the exam form. Download and print the form immediately. College Confirmation: Take the printed copy and your exam fees to your college's office/exam cell. Your form is not valid until the college confirms it on their portal.
3. Exam Fees Regular Fee: Typically around ₹600 for standard diploma courses. Late Fee: An additional ₹200 if you miss the first deadline. Super Penalty: If you miss even the late fee deadline, the penalty can go up to ₹1500.

1. Login on MSBTE Official Portal.
2. Verify Subjects (Theory/Practical).
3. Submit & Download PDF.
4. Submit hard copy + fee at college.

4. Checklist of Requirements Enrollment Number: This is your permanent ID for the entire diploma. Passport Photo/Signature: Usually, these are already in the system from your enrollment, but verify they are visible. Fees: Ensure you have the exact amount in the format required by your college (online payment, cash, or challan). Crucial Tip: Always check your subjects carefully before clicking submit. If there is a mistake in the elective subjects or backlog papers, only your college can rectify it through the RBTE (Regional Board of Technical Education).
• Enrollment Number & Password.\n• Check for backlogs/electives.\n• Passport photo/signature check.
